premise: Lola and Dog's picnic is rained on; they squeeze under the umbrella, Dog dashes out and comes back to shake all over Lola, and a rainbow makes it all worthwhile.
inspiration: The weathered-picnic of nursery stories, played for laughs: the rain is a game, the wet dog the joke, the rainbow the reward.
lesson: A spoiled plan can turn into the best part.

en-US.title: The Rainy Picnic
en-US.text: {umbrella:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola and {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Dog were having a picnic on the sand. {girl:face happy} {dog:live wag-tail} Then… plip. Plop. {canvas:rain 0.8 18s} {sfx:rain} Pitter-patter! Rain! {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [excited] "Quick, Dog! Under the umbrella!" {girl:go under umbrella} {dog:go under umbrella} {girl:live crouch hold} They squeezed in under the big red-and-white umbrella. {umbrella:pulse} Tap, tap, tap went the rain on top. {girl:face happy} Cosy! {dog:live play-bow} But Dog couldn't sit still. {dog:go to girl right} Out he dashed into the rain, {dog:face happy} round and round. Then back he came, {dog:go under umbrella} dripping wet, {dog:live shake} and SHOOK, right next to Lola. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [laughs] "Dog! Now I'm wetter than the rain!" [short pause] {canvas:rain stop} Then the rain stopped. {umbrella:live spin} The umbrella gave a little spin, flicking off the last drops. {canvas:rainbow 14s} [gasps] And there, over the bay, was a rainbow. {girl:face happy} {dog:face happy} {girl:says} [softly] "Worth getting wet for." {dog:hearts}

es-ES.title: El picnic con lluvia
es-ES.text: {umbrella:enter} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola y {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Perro estaban de picnic en la arena. {girl:face happy} {dog:live wag-tail} Entonces… plic. Ploc. {canvas:rain 0.8 18s} {sfx:rain} ¡Tip-tap! ¡Lluvia! {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [excited] «¡Rápido, Perro! ¡Debajo de la sombrilla!» {girl:go under umbrella} {dog:go under umbrella} {girl:live crouch hold} Se apretujaron bajo la gran sombrilla roja y blanca. {umbrella:pulse} Tac, tac, tac, hacía la lluvia encima. {girl:face happy} ¡Qué a gustito! {dog:live play-bow} Pero Perro no podía estarse quieto. {dog:go to girl right} Salió corriendo bajo la lluvia, {dog:face happy} vueltas y más vueltas. Luego volvió, {dog:go under umbrella} chorreando, {dog:live shake} y se SACUDIÓ justo al lado de Lola. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [laughs] «¡Perro! ¡Ahora estoy más mojada que la lluvia!» [short pause] {canvas:rain stop} Luego dejó de llover. {umbrella:live spin} La sombrilla dio una vueltecita, sacudiéndose las últimas gotas. {canvas:rainbow 14s} [gasps] Y allí, sobre la bahía, apareció un arcoíris. {girl:face happy} {dog:face happy} {girl:says} [softly] «Ha merecido la pena mojarse.» {dog:hearts}

ja-JP.title: あめの ピクニック
ja-JP.text: {umbrella:enter}{girl:enter}{girl:go to sand}ローラと{dog:enter}{dog:go to sand}イヌくんは、砂浜で、ピクニックをしていました。{girl:face happy}{dog:live wag-tail}すると…ぽつん。ぽつん。{canvas:rain 0.8 18s}{sfx:rain}ぱらぱらぱら！あめです！{girl:face surprised}{girl:says}[excited]「イヌくん、はやく！パラソルのしたへ！」 {girl:go under umbrella}{dog:go under umbrella}{girl:live crouch hold}赤と白の、大きなビーチパラソルのしたに、ぎゅうぎゅうもぐりこみました。{umbrella:pulse}あめが、うえで、とん、とん、とん。{girl:face happy}ぬくぬく！{dog:live play-bow}でも、イヌくんは、じっとしていられません。{dog:go to girl right}あめのなかへとびだして、{dog:face happy}ぐるぐる、ぐるぐる。それから、{dog:go under umbrella}びしょぬれでもどってきて、{dog:live shake}ローラのすぐよこで、ぶるぶるぶるっ！{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[laughs]「イヌくんったら！あめより、びっしょびしょ！」 [short pause]{canvas:rain stop}やがて、あめがやみました。{umbrella:live spin}パラソルが、くるっとまわって、さいごのしずくを、ぴっぴっ。{canvas:rainbow 14s}[gasps]海のむこうに、にじがかかっています。{girl:face happy}{dog:face happy}{girl:says}[softly]「ぬれても、よかったね」 {dog:hearts}
